name: Delivery to Andron Gant
label: Quest
description: Delivery to Andron Gant: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Andron Gant is my next contact. He usually holds himself up in the Undercity... Right near the Apothecarium.

He was a little more loose-lipped when it came to speaking about what he wanted the Tablet for. Apparently some of the mages of Undercity are looking to study some of the arcane spells the highborne used. They think this tablet will help them. Markri was adept at summoning creatures; especially elementals.
Take the Tablet of Markri and return to me for your part of the reward.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Well...... Isn't this a surprise? An adventurererere...!
What c'n I do for you...?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here, take some coin... Get yerself...... Some new armor or something....
This'll bring a shiny gold or two to the right... People.
